preconditions.description: The number of strings n must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string must have a length between 1 and 100.
All strings must consist of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to reorder the strings, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by the strings in the required order.

postconditions.expression: all(strings[i] in strings[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', each string must be a substring of the next string in the output.
